metadata.title: That ONE kill that looks like a total misclick but somehow worked in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Wait, did I actually mean to do that? Nope, still shocked.
VALORANT logic just blessed my terrible aim.
Watch me act like it was planned all along.

Click if your worst shot ever turned into a highlight!
